blind_check.note: 40 flagged + 40 unflagged pre-event tiles, shuffled, numbers only; called by eye (agent ART) before reading the key; rule-only tiles were mostly blur-flagged tiles that looked acceptable; eye-only = 2 sparse tissue-edge tiles (tissue share > 0.15) and 1 pale soft tile

random_unflagged_96: no clear artefact seen by eye

flag.edge: straight band (3-line mean) with >= 50% dark unstained pixels
